geopolitics.status: Iran says the Strait stays closed until its conditions are met; IMF PortWatch counted 4 transits on Oct 18 vs. a pre-crisis ~85/day. October is the worst month yet for attacks on shipping (Reuters/Washington Institute). The IRGC claims mine strikes on tankers; Washington dismissed its latest claim. Houthi attacks hit Saudi energy sites and Aramco evacuated its Dhahran HQ on Oct 22. Efforts to end the US-Israel war on Iran are deadlocked; on Oct 23 Trump said the war could end quickly or wind down gradually.
geopolitics.market_effect: Brent settled $116.72 on Oct 23 (+3.1%), highest close since Apr 29 and +6% on the week; WTI $103.27. US SPR is at its lowest since 1982. Oil up, inflation and rate-hike fears up.
geopolitics.hurt: Airlines, cruise lines, consumer discretionary, chemicals (fuel & feedstock costs)
geopolitics.watch_stocks: XOM, CVX, SHEL, TTE, COP, BP (helped); LMT, RTX (defense); TSLA vs. gas-price effect; DAL/UAL not in top 10 but most hurt
geopolitics.next: Further tanker attacks or a reopening deal; Houthi moves near Bab el-Mandeb; any new reserve releases
geopolitics.source: Nation Thailand (Reuters), Oct 24; Straits.live brief, Oct 23; Al Jazeera, Oct 23, 2026

geopolitics.status: Fed raised rates 0.25% in September to 3.75-4.00%. September CPI rose 3.7% y/y (core 2.6%) and PPI jumped 1.3% m/m. CME FedWatch shows about 88% odds of a hold on Oct 28; some analysts say a December hike is close to fully priced.
geopolitics.market_effect: Higher oil is feeding rate-hike bets; Treasury yields elevated and gold headed for a steep weekly loss.
geopolitics.hurt: REITs, utilities, high-growth tech, gold & silver, small caps
geopolitics.watch_stocks: JPM, BAC, BRK.B (rates help); WELL, PLD, NEE, SO (rates hurt); NVDA, AMD (high-valuation tech)
geopolitics.next: Oct 28 FOMC statement and press conference; October CPI

geopolitics.status: Midterms Nov 3, 2026, six days after the Fed meeting. Energy prices and inflation are campaign issues; Trump has accused Tehran of staging attacks to influence the vote (Jerusalem Post via Straits.live).
geopolitics.market_effect: Adds uncertainty; markets often choppy in the weeks before.
geopolitics.helped: Historically, stocks have tended to rise in the months after midterms (pattern, not a rule)
geopolitics.hurt: Sectors tied to policy fights: healthcare (drug pricing), energy, defense
geopolitics.watch_stocks: UNH, LLY, PFE-type pharma; XOM, CVX; LMT
geopolitics.next: Nov 3 results and control of House & Senate

geopolitics.status: Supreme Court struck down IEEPA tariffs Feb 20, 2026. A 10% replacement tariff (Section 122) expired Jul 24. Since Jul 24, Section 301 tariffs of 10-12.5% apply to imports from 60 economies; new Section 232 probes, including semiconductors, are underway. IEEPA refunds require claims.
geopolitics.market_effect: Lower legal certainty than 2025; costs remain for importers.
geopolitics.helped: US-based manufacturers with domestic supply; companies owed refunds
geopolitics.hurt: Retailers that import (cost pressure), automakers, consumer electronics
geopolitics.watch_stocks: WMT, COST, TJX, HD, AMZN (import costs); TM, TSLA (autos); AAPL (electronics); TSM, ASML (chip tariffs)
geopolitics.next: Section 232 semiconductor tariff decision; Federal Circuit appeal on Section 122

geopolitics.status: Since May 31, 2026, the US requires licenses to ship advanced AI chips (Nvidia Blackwell & Rubin, AMD MI350x) to any China-headquartered company, wherever it operates.
geopolitics.market_effect: Caps part of China demand for US AI chips; adds headline risk. Chips led today's sell-off (other factors too).
geopolitics.hurt: AI chip makers and equipment suppliers with China exposure
geopolitics.watch_stocks: NVDA, AMD, AVGO, MU, INTC, ASML, TSM, SKHY
geopolitics.next: China revenue guidance in upcoming earnings; any Beijing retaliation

geopolitics.status: US forces captured Nicolas Maduro in January 2026. On Sep 2, Chevron said it will invest more than $7B over five years to roughly double its Venezuelan output to ~600,000 bpd, with new terms and added Orinoco acreage; output at its joint ventures was up 15% year to date.
geopolitics.market_effect: Long-term: more potential heavy-crude supply. Short-term: little effect next to Middle East disruptions.
geopolitics.helped: Chevron (only US major already operating there)
geopolitics.hurt: Over time, higher supply could weigh on oil prices
geopolitics.watch_stocks: CVX (positioned), COP (has old claims there), refiners that run heavy crude: VLO, MPC, PSX
geopolitics.next: Chevron's production ramp and any new licenses for other US companies
geopolitics.source: World Oil, Sep 2, 2026; E&E News, Jan 7, 2026

geopolitics.status: Fighting continues. Trump announced an 'energy ceasefire' the weekend of Oct 11 and Ukraine briefly paused refinery strikes, then resumed them, saying Russia never observed it and kept attacking Ukraine's grid. On Oct 18 Ukraine sent about 1,000 drones at Moscow and St. Petersburg, hitting an oil terminal. Trump waived a congressional sanctions package on Russian oil and gas and agreed to lift sanctions on Russian diesel.
geopolitics.market_effect: Strikes on Russian refining and export sites keep diesel supply tight; supports refiners and defense.
geopolitics.watch_stocks: VLO, MPC, PSX (refining margins); LMT, RTX, GD; BP, SHEL, TTE
geopolitics.next: Whether any energy truce is revived; more refinery and terminal strikes; sanctions changes

trump_people.disclosed: 3,642 trades in Q1 2026 alone (Jan-Mar), mostly buys; Aug 2026 filing lists 517 more. Also 327 stock buys on Apr 8, 2025 (day before the tariff pause), reported over a year late, and 175+ bond purchases ($82M-$337M) Aug 28-Oct 2, 2025. See Part 2 for named trades.
trump_people.status: Trades documented in official filings. Critics allege some trades came shortly before policy moves; no finding of wrongdoing reported. Late-filing fees paid for the Apr 2025 trades.
trump_people.response: Trump Organization: accounts run by independent third-party managers; family does not pick trades. OGE declines to comment on specific filings. Sen. Warren called for an investigation.

trump_people.disclosed: Holds about 331,580 shares of drone maker Unusual Machines (UMAC), adviser since Nov 2024. PSQ Holdings board seat (Dec 2024). Partner at 1789 Capital (invested in Anduril). Adviser to Polymarket and Kalshi.
trump_people.status: Holdings documented; conflict-of-interest concerns raised. No wrongdoing finding reported.

trump_people.disclosed: Investor in the all-stock merger taking Israeli drone maker XTEND public via JFB Construction (announced Feb 17, 2026; $1.5B deal; planned ticker XTND). Personal stake not disclosed.
trump_people.status: Investment documented; no wrongdoing finding reported.
trump_people.response: Defended his father's trades; said family assets are invested in broad market indexes.

trump_people.role: DHS Secretary (Senator when trades were made)
trump_people.disclosed: Big-tech buys in Nov-Dec 2025 ($50K-$500K each); Chevron and Raytheon (RTX) bought days before the January 2026 Venezuela operation; 17 trades on Feb 4, 2026. See Part 2.
trump_people.status: Trades documented in Senate disclosures; timing allegations. No wrongdoing finding reported.
trump_people.response: Spokesperson: Mullin had no input on trades made by the firm that manages his account.

trump_people.disclosed: Bet on Kalshi 'mention markets' (whether Trump would say certain words in speeches) Dec 2025-Feb 2026, using advance access to speech text.
trump_people.status: Established: CFTC settlement Aug 2026 - give up $107,539 in profits plus a $65,000 penalty (about $172K total) and a 3-year trading ban. Placed on unpaid leave in July 2026 and did not return.
trump_people.response: Reported as fully cooperative with regulators.
